text.name: Estonian Cyberattacks 2007
text.rules: Draw from SAE's Contingency deck. If the result is 3 or more, record "sites down", then SAE spends 2 points; otherwise, record "cyber defence doctrine", then LIO spends 1 point.
text.history: From 27 April 2007 Estonian government, bank and media websites were hit by weeks of denial-of-service attacks after a dispute over moving a Soviet war memorial in Tallinn.
